g.text: ⇒ the nondiscrete-joint field target is affine. OM8

g.text: Entirely discrete spectra are excluded, even with unbounded ramification.

g.text: An all-discrete chosen norming subset alone does not imply this conclusion.

g.text: For countable K, a closed Cantor subset can consist entirely of dense-group valuations.
